testcase.name: Scenario: Open a second window for a part and returns to the first: tmp/obk-second-window-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:387:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a second window for a part and returns to the first ✔ Given a saved part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a sketch is being edited in the part ✔ When the user chooses New in the View tab's Windows group ✔ Then a second window for the same part becomes active ✔ And the new window has a numbered document tab ✔ And the application title identifies the second window number ✔ And the part's model browser is displayed ✔ When the user opens the Switch menu on the View tab ✔ Then the original part window is listed with a different window number ✔ When the user selects the original part window ✔ Then the original sketch viewport is displayed ✔ And the original numbered document tab is active ✔ And the second window remains open
